title: RAGFlow: 89K Stars for Smarter Document AI
description: Discover RAGFlow, the open-source RAG engine that understands documents deeply. See how it uses OCR and layout analysis to answer questions with citations. Perfect for building AI apps over messy documents. Learn more at https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow
